headline: OASIS 🍂 Doc 🍿 GLOSSES 😶 Over The HARD 🍆 Stuff
text:
NOEL 🎸 and LIAM 🧔 Gallagher just PREMIERED 🎬 their emotional documentary at the VENICE 🎥 Film Festival over the weekend 🌊 and it's got everyone feeling some type of WAY 😢!! "The little things that used to ANNOY 😤 us about each other have all gone AWAY 🕊️" says Noel Gallagher of RECONCILING 🤝 with his brother Liam who he now calls his ride or DIE 🩸!! "It's not a power struggle any MORE 💪" he adds while the camera catches them sharing a moment that hits different at the end of Don't Look Back In Anger which is basically a sentimental and AFFECTIONATE 💕 portrait of the band's massive 2025 comeback TOUR 🏟️!! But bro it's about as DEEP 🕳️ as we get into their brutal 15 year HIATUS 😶‍🌫️ leaving fans thirsty for the real TEA ☕!!

In an opening MONTAGE 📼 we hear how Oasis absolutely CONQUERED 🌍 the world back in the 1990s with absolute BANGERS 🎤 like Wonderwall and Roll With It but as their FAME 📈 grew so did the brothers ANIMOUSITY 🔥 until the whole party came to an abrupt HALT 🛑 backstage at a gig in PARIS 🗼 in 2009!! Fan shot FOOTAGE 📹 shows the promoter on stage telling the CROWD 👥 that the concert is CANCELLED ❌ following a huge fight together in the dressing room and he drops the bomb "The band doesn't exist any MORE 🚫" sounding more IRRITATED 😒 than sad!! Scottish singer Amy McDonald who was also on the LINEUP 🎟️ called it seismic tweeting "Liam smashed Noel's guitar huuuge FIGHT 🥊" from backstage but the film never tells us what was SAID 🗣️ or who started the RAPPROCHEMENT 🤝 nor how it wrecked their FAMILY 👨‍👧‍👦!!

Instead we suddenly CUT ✂️ to rehearsals for the comeback tour with a caption saying the brothers didn't SPEAK 🦻 for 15 years and an implication that all the WOUNDS 🩹 have been miraculously healed like some kind of emotional MAGIC ✨!! Tantalisingly the first song they PRACTICE 🎼 is Columbia a fan favourite that never made the tour's SETLIST 📋 but there's serious TENSION 😣 in the room while the band under Noel's instruction is piecing together the SETLIST 📝!! Liam won't arrive until later in the process and no one's sure which LIAM 😠 they'll even get when he finally shows up looking fantastically GRUMPY 😾 complaining about the sound proofing panels that have been placed in front of Joey Waronker's DRUMS 🥁 saying "They're already giving me the HUMP 🦎"!!

The documentary shows that the brothers RECONCILIATION 🤗 was as genuine off stage as it was in front of the FANS 👏 but when Liam steps up to the MIC 🎤 the whole band just RELAXES 😌 and guitarist Bonehead strategically placed between Liam and Noel beams from ear to EAR 👂!! A couple of hours later still in the middle of a SONG 🎶 Liam waves goodbye and casually strolls out of the rehearsal SPACE 🚪 leaving Noel to tell his bandmates "I'm not sure whether our kid's enjoying himself" in the most brotherly way POSSIBLE 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! In a voice over Liam reveals that enjoying himself wasn't even the GOAL 🎯 saying "If you're not on it chaos can ENSUE 🔥" while adding he's given up cigarettes and alcohol for the duration of the tour because "These songs they need to be treated with the utmost RESPECT 🙌"!!

Liam's newfound PROFESSIONALISM 💼 is probably the biggest revelation in this documentary scripted by Peaky Blinders creator Steven Knight and shot by directors Dylan Southern and Will Lovelace who to their dismay skipped all the classic Liam MOMENTS 🌪️ like quitting the tour to go house hunting or throwing snooker balls at Blur or starting a fight on a cross channel FERRY ⛴️!! Instead they complete rehearsals without incident and rock up to Cardiff's Principality Stadium for their public REUNION 🔥 where everyone limbers up in the corridors like middle aged DADS 🧔 getting ready for a Park Run but when they hit the STAGE 🎸 it's absolutely ELECTRIC ⚡!! Liam grabs Noel's hand and thrusts it into the air they launch into the opening chords of Hello and the crowd practically EXPLODES 💥 with joy dancing cheering and weeping through every single SONG 🎵!!

During Slide Away a man literally sinks to his knees and sings the lyrics with hands clasped together as if in PRAYER 🙏 while cameras capture a young fan in an awe struck STUPOR 😲 unable to tear himself away from his spot on the stadium floor and this is exactly where the documentary EXCELS 🏆 at capturing the sheer surge of affection that greeted Oasis return across shows in Dublin Manchester Sao Paolo Tokyo and New York where every crowd has a fan with a personal STORY 📖!! One woman has named her dog Bonehead another is a Haenyeo South Korean free diver who says Oasis music helped her out of depression and Noel in particular is completely BLINDSIDED 😵 by the impact admitting "The gravity hit me of what it meant to people and it took me by surprise I have to say it actually knocked me BACK"!! Structurally though the film has a PROBLEM 🧩 because in a normal biopic the triumphant night in Cardiff would have been the FINAL 🎬 scene but here it comes about 40 minutes in and every subsequent concert just rinses and repeats the same STORY 📽️ leaving the directors flailing around for actual NARRATIVE 📜 while still delivering impeccable live MIX 🎚️ and incredible vocals from Liam who sounds straight up otherworldly!! The film hits cinemas worldwide on Wednesday 9 September and serves as the perfect tear soaked souvenir or an effective trailer for their rumoured return to Knebworth next summer but yeah it totally glosses over the hard STUFF 🪨 like the dynamic pricing row the Manchester Arena bombing context Bonehead's cancer diagnosis and all those unpulled family THREADS 🧵!!
